en:
<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the courtyard.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we talk about?
I've gotten used to being here...
I want to get outside as soon as I can...
Staying here forever wouldn't be so bad

To think that I'd get used to a warm 
life like this... Even I'm surprised.

But for some reason...I'm happy I'm
even able to feel this way.

If I was able to change...
it was thanks to you.

Yeah... It'd be great to see 
everyone's smiling faces...

Sorry...
Can I be alone for a while?

You have people who worry 
about you, don't you?

Then...don't say things like that!
Even as a joke!

<CLT=cltMIND>I wonder what's wrong?
Ryoma looks deep in thought...
